tickets.title: Obtain Velvet Acorn lapse reinstatement details for Arlo Copperwisp
tickets.text: Obtain from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance the reinstatement terms, catch-up premium, conversion availability, and any underwriting requirements for Arlo Copperwisp's $1.5 million term life policy that entered grace or lapse status after a premium draft failed from a closed Pocket Lantern Bank account.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain that carrier information by March 1, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain Velvet Acorn beneficiary evidence for Arlo Copperwisp
tickets.text: Obtain current carrier evidence from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance for the beneficiary arrangement on Arlo Copperwisp's term policy, since the portal shows a different arrangement than the beneficiary summary retained in the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text:
Request Arlo and Lena Copperwisp's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation.

The 2016 Buttonwood Balloon Legal binder names Lena as Arlo's primary agent and Jules Copperwisp as successor trustee, but the estate binder lacks trust funding evidence and includes fiduciary role information that may not reflect the current household and insurance beneficiary structure.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to Arlo and Lena Copperwisp and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location. Reference the 2016 Buttonwood Balloon Legal binder already on file.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles (Lena as Arlo's primary agent, Jules Copperwisp as successor trustee), successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed. Flag the missing trust funding evidence and any beneficiary discrepancies with the Velvet Acorn Life Insurance arrangement.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect the estate planning documents by March 22, 2024.
